instruction.text: Now, you are facing towards the refrigerator. Move towards your right and turn around from the cupboard. You will find a table in front of you. Move towards it, cross the microwave oven. You will find an entrance. Enter through it and take right. You will find a big black bowl. Pass through it. Cross the chairs on your left side and walk straight. You will find a big entrance with a step. Go up taking the steps and move towards your left side. Cross the cupboard on your left side. You will find the staircase going downwards in front of you. Take the stairs and go down. Once you reached down, you will find an open door onto your left side. Enter through it and move towards your left side. You will find a sofa beside you and that will be your end point facing a table with a lamp and a window behind it.
